questions.question: If $A = \begin{bmatrix} \cos\theta & -\sin\theta \\ \sin\theta & \cos\theta \end{bmatrix}$, find $|A|$. (b) Show that $A A^T = I$.
questions.solution_html:
(a) $|A| = \cos^2\theta - (-\sin^2\theta) = \cos^2\theta + \sin^2\theta = 1$.

(b) Since the columns are orthonormal, $A A^T = I$.

questions.question: Define intersection of sets. If $A \subseteq B$, then find $A \cap B$.
questions.solution_html: The intersection $A \cap B = \{x \mid x \in A \text{ and } x \in B\}$. If $A \subseteq B$, every element in $A$ is in $B$, hence $A \cap B = A$.
